records.subject: Transport
records.title: Sea Passenger Handled, Quarterly
records.footnote: Covers international cruise and regional ferry passengers that are handled by Singapore Cruise Centre at all three terminals operated by Singapore Cruise Centre, namely, International Passenger Terminal (cruise passengers) and Regional Ferry Terminal (ferry passengers) at HarbourFront Centre and Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal (ferry passengers).  Data refer to the sum of arriving and departing regional ferry passengers; and the sum of all embarking cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived in Singapore by air or land but departed on a cruise), disembarking cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived on a cruise ship but departed by other means) and full-cruise passengers (i.e. those who arrived and departed on the same cruise ship).  The numbers include all cruise and ferry passengers who are international travellers, Singaporean citizens or permanent residents.
